title: R & D Machine and Engineering
description: &D Machine and Engineering, LLC specializes in CNC machining of precision metal components primarily for the aerospace, defense, and space industries. The company is known for its ability to maintain tight tolerances and produce complex geometries using advanced 5-axis milling and coordinate measuring machines. With a commitment to quality, R&D Machine has built a strong customer base that includes respected blue-chip companies like NASA. Acquired by Compass Precision in 2022, the company continues to focus on manufacturing mission-critical components for demanding applications.
